generalAbilities.name: Motion Sense
generalAbilities.description: An szynegator swarm can sense nearby creatures through vibrations in air or water caused by movement as an imprecise sense at the listed range.

defensiveAbilities.name: Colony Mind
defensiveAbilities.description: 30 feet. All allies with colony mind within the listed range of each other are in constant telepathic communication and are aware of all threats any individual knows about. While within range of at least one ally with colony mind, when a creature rolls a success on a save against a mental effect, it gets a critical success instead.

defensiveAbilities.name: Comm Occlusion
defensiveAbilities.description: 40 feet. All electronic and telepathic communication, except for that with the colony mind ability, ceases to function, and affected creatures take a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks. When three or more szynegator swarms are aware of each other using colony mind, the range of comm occlusion increases to 100 feet. This range increases to planetary when 10 or more szynegator swarms are aware of each other using colony mind.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sonic Distortion
offensiveAbilities.description: Each enemy in the szynegator swarm's space takes 1d8 Sonic Damage damage (Basic DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save).
